title: SCE 1.8 – Detect Malicious CodeBuild Invocation (Attack Node 1.7: Start Malicious Build)
description: Validates the detective control for unauthorised / malicious CodeBuild project execution. A rogue CodeBuild project is created and a build is deliberately triggered (StartBuild). An EventBridge rule captures the build-state-change event and routes it to a CloudWatch Logs group. A CloudWatch metric filter increments a counter, and a CloudWatch Alarm transitions to ALARM state. The hypothesis verifies – via real AWS API calls – that either the alarm fired or log events are present in the detective log group, confirming the control observed the malicious build invocation.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: CloudWatch Alarm or Log Group captures malicious CodeBuild StartBuild event

probes.name: Verify detective control detected the malicious build invocation

method.name: Deploy CloudFormation stack with CodeBuild project, EventBridge rule, CloudWatch log group and alarm

rollbacks.name: Delete CloudFormation stack and all provisioned resources
